title: Lime dal with roast squash and chilli cashews

source.title: Rukmini Iyer's quick and easy recipe for lime dal with roast squash and chilli cashews

ingredients.name: Neutral or olive oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp, plus 1 tsp for the cashews

instructions: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7. Toss the cubed squash with the oil, 1 tsp salt, the ground coriander and cumin in a roasting tin large enough for one layer. Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until cooked through and catching at the edges.

Meanwhile, put the rinsed lentils in a large pan with 500ml just-boiled water, the garlic and the turmeric. Bring to the boil, partially cover, lower the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft.
Mix the cashews, oil, chilli flakes and a big pinch of salt in a small tray. When the squash has 8 minutes left, put the cashews in the oven too.
Whisk the dal and season generously with lime juice and salt, tasting as you go, then add the butter. For a silky finish, blitz the dal with the garlic clove in a blender.
Divide between two bowls, top with the squash and cashews, scatter with coriander and serve with rice or bread.
